prompt: How many different customers placed at least one order in the last 30 days up to Voltmarkt's as-of date, 5 January 2026, with the as-of day included: from 7 December 2025 to 5 January 2026? Order times are stored in UTC, so place each order on its UTC day. Guest orders have no customer_id and do not count. Return one column, customers. Return one row. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the row filter: every order from the first moment of 7 December 2025 to the last moment of 5 January 2026.
Thirty days with the as-of day included start 29 days before it. Count each customer once, however many orders they placed; a missing customer_id is not a customer.
why_this_works: The range keeps exactly the 30 days up to and including 5 January, and COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) counts each customer once and skips guest orders.
